title: Exec status update
summary: Tell an impatient VP the launch is slipping and get one decision from them.
goal: Get approval to borrow one engineer from the payments team for four weeks.
scenario: Your launch is slipping three weeks. You need one more engineer to stop it slipping further.

attendees.name: Grace
likely_objections: What exactly do you need decided today?
attendees.knows: Runs the weekly staff meeting and keeps it to time.

attendees.name: Martin
likely_objections: Why am I hearing about this now?
What's the date, and how confident are you?
What happens if I say no?
attendees.knows: Promised the launch date to the leadership team. Has 15 minutes for this item.

attendees.name: Nadia
likely_objections: Which of my engineers, and for how long exactly?
My team has a compliance deadline in April
attendees.knows: Her team has a compliance deadline on April 30.

hidden_concerns: The red items and what caused them
What exactly is needed from them
success: Martin makes a clear decision on the engineer and nothing new comes out late.
tips: Lead with the answer: the slip, the cause and your ask.
Have the cost to the payments team ready before Nadia asks.
Give a new date with how confident you are in it.

key_facts.label: Cause
key_facts.value: Payment provider integration took 3 weeks longer

ask: Lend us one payments engineer for four weeks starting Monday.
